sources.provider: Purdue University Campus Map ArcGIS feature service
sources.measurement_method: Feature ring projected to project local meters using origin 40.4274,-86.9137 and the repository's documented longitude/latitude factors; exact local polygon saved in sources/purdue_gis_fid432_dudley_hall.json.
sources.uncertainty: Official campus map outline, not a certified survey; no building height or elevation is encoded.

sources.provider: Ennead Architects; exterior photograph credited on project page to Jeff Goldberg/Esto
sources.source_date: project photography published 2023; exact capture date not stated
sources.measurement_method: Visual reference for brick portions, broad curtainwall entry, pale projecting volume, and terracotta-colored vertical screen; not used as a metric elevation.
sources.uncertainty: Photograph shows the combined Dudley-Lambertus complex; mapping individual visible facade zones onto the Dudley GIS polygon is approximate.

sources.measurement_method: Published report identifies Dudley as four stories plus basement and estimates 145,000 square feet; floor count supports a schematic four-level above-grade treatment, not surveyed floor-to-floor dimensions.
sources.uncertainty: Later project sources give 250,000-255,000 square feet for the combined Dudley-Lambertus complex. Those combined-area figures are not treated as Dudley-only area.

sources.measurement_method: Project description supports simple brick forms and a terracotta-shaded curtainwall in the linked complex.
sources.uncertainty: Description addresses both connected halls and does not provide facade dimensions or a Dudley-only elevation.

changes: Preserved the existing official-GIS-derived structural shell and campus-coordinate frame.
Added schematic four-level window bands, a broad glass entry bay, facade mullions, a terracotta-screen cue, and horizontal facade stringcourses based on the cited architect photo.
Added a repeatable dedicated builder at modular/buildings/build_dudley_hall.py and saved a fresh rendered preview.
Added a paired entry-door cue beneath the central south curtainwall; the exact doorway width and bay are estimated from the architect photograph.
validation: Reopened the saved library in Blender 4.5.15. The 65 unique lower-shell XY vertices match the 66-point closed FID 432 ring with symmetric nearest-vertex maximum error 0.0001 m. The Asset_dudley_hall collection contains the structural shell plus five combined detail meshes (2,760 detail faces).
remaining_uncertainty: GIS height field is explicitly unverified; the 16.0 m shell height is estimated and does not include a measured basement depth.
Facade assignments, glazing extents, story heights, and terracotta screen placement are schematic interpretations of a combined-building photo.
No measured roof elevation or individual Dudley-only exterior elevation was located.
grade_status: independent grade pending; not marked passed
